The '''Colette EM4''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] created by [[Vectron]] during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref>https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20260804-0</ref>
